enumeration_rule: A source-bound consumed CSI-u packet has primary 65..90 and an already-set Shift modifier bit ((modifiers-1)&1). Propose replacing primary with primary+32 only; preserve all other fields and the complete test oracle.

items.complete_test:
async def test_kitty_release_is_delivered_without_running_binding(parser):
    class PhaseApp(App[None]):
        BINDINGS = [("a", "match", "Match")]

        phases: list[str] = []
        matched = False

        def on_key(self, event: Key) -> None:
            self.phases.append(event.phase)

        def action_match(self) -> None:
            self.matched = True

    [event] = parser.feed("\x1b[65;4u")
    app = PhaseApp()
    async with app.run_test() as pilot:
        app.post_message(event)
        await pilot.pause()

    assert app.phases == ["release"]
    assert not app.matched
items.manual_full_oracle_risk: The fixed packet has no event-type subfield, so its phase defaults to press. The retained app assertion expects release. Lowering the primary does not change the phase and cannot justify this oracle. Normal positive result flow also stays outside the bounded guard proof.

items.complete_test:
def test_kitty_non_shift_modified_printable_has_no_character(parser):
    """Non-shift modified printable shortcuts keep a mod+key name and no character."""
    (event,) = _keys(parser, "[65;2u")
    assert event.key == "alt+shift+a"
    assert event.character is None
    assert event.modifiers == ("alt", "shift")
    assert event.base_key == "a"
    assert event.alt is True
    assert event.shift is True
items.manual_full_oracle_risk: Modifier value 2 means Shift only. The retained complete test expects Alt+Shift, alt=True and character=None. Lowering the primary does not change the modifier bits or make these expectations follow from the issue; shift-only printable semantics require separate review.
